episodes.title: The Bumpy Road to Love
episodes.plot: Adam drags Joel into treating hypochondriac Eve and their volatile marriage, while Maggie discovers Rick had another girlfriend and Maurice's courtship of Barbara hits an ethical wall.

episodes.title: Only You
episodes.plot: Chris discovers his pheromones attract nearly every woman except the optometrist he wants, while Maurice and Holling reopen old resentment over Shelly and Maggie confronts aging.

episodes.title: Oy, Wilderness
episodes.plot: An emergency landing leaves Maggie and Joel stranded and arguing over survival, while Shelly's visiting best friend puts unexpected strain on life at the Brick.

episodes.title: Animals 'R' Us
episodes.plot: Maggie becomes convinced Rick has been reincarnated as a dog, Maurice dreams of an ostrich empire, and Ed turns his camera toward ordinary Cicely life.

episodes.title: Jules et Joel
episodes.plot: After a head injury, Joel is confronted by his slick, disreputable twin Jules, whose arrival lets the brothers swap places and destabilize Joel's already fragile sense of control.

episodes.title: The Body in Question
episodes.plot: A century-old frozen body forces Cicely to debate history, ownership and mortality, while Maurice spots a business opportunity and Shelly wonders about fertility.

episodes.title: Roots
episodes.plot: Elaine returns to Cicely as a widow and Maggie unexpectedly nudges her toward Joel, while a gifted new cook changes expectations at the Brick.

episodes.title: A-Hunting We Will Go
episodes.plot: Joel reluctantly joins Chris and Holling for hunting season, while Ed becomes convinced death is stalking Ruth-Anne and tries to protect her.

episodes.title: Get Real
episodes.plot: A stranded performance troupe brings a silent flying man who charms Marilyn, while Shelly is wounded when Holling comments on a physical insecurity.

episodes.title: Seoul Mates
episodes.plot: Christmas brings Joel his first tree in Cicely and Maurice an unexpected Korean family connection, while the town stages its own idiosyncratic holiday pageant.

episodes.title: Dateline: Cicely
episodes.plot: Maurice hires a secretive reporter to enliven his newspaper, Maggie finds meaning in talking to trees, and Chris becomes financially entangled with the Brick.

episodes.title: Our Tribe
episodes.plot: A grateful elder adopts Joel into his clan after giving him a goat, while Holling mysteriously closes the Brick and leaves everyone guessing why.

episodes.title: Things Become Extinct
episodes.plot: Ed documents an elder's disappearing cultural knowledge while Holling, at sixty-three, is abruptly seized by a midlife crisis.

episodes.title: Burning Down the House
episodes.plot: Maggie's impeccably polite mother arrives with unsettling news, while Chris becomes consumed by an ambitious and dangerous new piece of performance art.

episodes.title: Democracy in America
episodes.plot: Holling's comfortable position as mayor is challenged by Edna, whose campaign turns a forgotten civic promise into a surprisingly serious election.

episodes.title: Three Amigos
episodes.plot: Holling and Maurice head deep into the wilderness to honor a promise and bury an old friend, only to find the dead man's widow complicating the expedition.

episodes.title: Lost and Found
episodes.plot: Joel becomes convinced his house is haunted by a long-dead loner, while Eve acquires fresh symptoms and Maurice eagerly accepts a favor for an old military acquaintance.

episodes.title: My Mother, My Sister
episodes.plot: An abandoned infant in Joel's waiting room becomes a town-wide responsibility just as Shelly receives an unexpected visit from her mother.

episodes.title: Wake Up Call
episodes.plot: Spring transforms Cicely: Shelly searches for renewal, Joel refreshes his medical instincts and Maggie experiences an awakening that makes old emotional boundaries harder to maintain.

episodes.title: The Final Frontier
episodes.plot: Japanese visitors arrive for a northern-lights ritual, Holling resumes his search for Jesse the bear, and a mysterious well-traveled package captivates the town.

episodes.title: It Happened in Juneau
episodes.plot: Joel's hoped-for medical weekend in Juneau becomes an awkward shared hotel stay with Maggie, while Bernard's return unsettles Chris's sense of identity.

episodes.title: Our Wedding
episodes.plot: Adam and Eve's wedding reveals an unexpected truth about the bride, while Joel and Maggie consider finishing the romantic encounter they began in Juneau.

episodes.title: Cicely
episodes.plot: An elderly visitor recounts how Cicely began as a frontier haven for artists, outsiders and free thinkers, revealing the town's idealistic founding story.
